set_text.text: The calculator takes the 6% off the invoice before the 2%. If your tier comes back later as a rebate, the invoice stays at $24.00, so enter the volume discount as 0%.
The calculator trusts the $24.00 you type. Ten days is not long to check a delivery against its invoice, and paying early on a wrong one leaves you chasing a credit.
Where VOS fits when you are the buyer
Supplier payments stay with you and your books

VOS does not calculate discounts, pay suppliers or touch your payables. It works on the selling side: orders your accounts place by voice in the VOS app, each one confirmed and timestamped. Paying early stays your decision, made in your own books.
Accounts order by voice in the app, day or night
A number, date and timestamp on every app order
Order history for each account, kept in one place
Runs alongside your ERP, with nothing to rip out
